commentary.text: 90+11' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+10' Alberto Moreno (Como) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Alessandro Prontera stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Udinese are awarded the free kick.
90+10' A pass from Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) is intercepted by Maduka Okoye and the move breaks down.
90+9' Iker Bravo (Udinese) is cautioned by the referee.
90+8' Alieu Fadera (Como) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
90+7' The ball is out of play. Como win a corner kick.
90+5' Patrick Cutrone (Como) fails to score from the penalty spot! His effort crashes against the left post. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
90+5' Patrick Cutrone (Como) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+5' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
90+3' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Como! Let's see what he decides.
90+2' Surely that's handball by one of the Udinese players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
90+1' Today's referee Alessandro Prontera rightly decides to book Jordan Zemura (Udinese) for his harsh tackle.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
89' Martin Payero (Udinese) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
88' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) glances on a header from the corner sent into the near post, but his close-range effort is blocked by a defender.
88' Sergi Roberto (Como) takes the corner.
86' Nico Paz (Como) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
85' Udinese will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
84' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The ball goes out of play. Udinese are awarded a corner kick.
83' Cesc Fabregas decides to make a substitution. Gabriel Strefezza will be replaced by Alessandro Gabrielloni (Como).
83' The game has come to an end for Christian Kabasele. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Thomas Kristensen (Udinese).
81' Although Kosta Runjaic (Udinese) is just on the bench, Alessandro Prontera has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
81' Keinan Davis (Udinese) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
80' A cross into the box from Nico Paz (Como) is cleared.
79' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Sandi Lovric as he is replaced by Martin Payero (Udinese).
78' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Alessandro Prontera blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Udinese in a dangerous position.

77' Nico Paz (Como) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
76' Poor challenge! Nico Paz (Como) is penalised for tripping and Alessandro Prontera blows his whistle. That's a free kick to Udinese.

74' Keinan Davis (Udinese) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
71' A cooling break is underway.
71' Nico Paz (Como) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
70' Here comes a substitution. Iker Bravo (Udinese) is brought on as a substitute for Florian Thauvin.
70' Kosta Runjaic has decided to substitute Lorenzo Lucca and he is replaced by Keinan Davis (Udinese).
69' That's the end of the game for Brenner, who is replaced by Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese).
69' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
68' Cesc Fabregas (Como) gets a yellow card, off the field.
68' Alessandro Prontera shows the yellow card to Jaka Bijol (Udinese) for a heavy challenge.
67' A quickly taken corner by Como.
63' Here comes a substitution. Luca Mazzitelli is given a rest as he is replaced by Sergi Roberto (Como).
63' Cesc Fabregas prepares a substitution. Lucas Da Cunha is replaced by Alieu Fadera (Como).
63' We are about to witness a substitution. Nico Paz (Como) is replacing Andrea Belotti.
62' Referee Alessandro Prontera sees the trip by Jordan Zemura (Udinese) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. A free kick to Como.
61' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Sandi Lovric (Udinese) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
60' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a low header towards middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes to stop the effort.
60' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
60' Luca Mazzitelli (Como) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Como have a corner.
59' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Pepe Reina has no trouble gathering it.
58' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) was too forceful with his tackle and Alessandro Prontera interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Udinese earn a free kick.
57' Brenner (Udinese) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
57' Brenner (Udinese) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. The ball goes out of play. Udinese are awarded a corner kick.

54' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Alessandro Prontera blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. A free kick has been awarded to Como.

52' Excellent touch by Gabriel Strefezza (Como)! He latches on to an inch-perfect pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper reacts superbly and makes a save.
49' A snap shot by Lucas Da Cunha (Como) from the edge of the area flies towards the right side of the goal, but Maduka Okoye produces a good save to thwart him.
46' Alessio Iovine will be replaced by Ignace Van der Brempt (Como).
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+3' A short pass finds Gabriel Strefezza (Como) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.

43' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Brenner (Udinese) darts into the box to collect a fantastic lofted pass from Kingsley Ehizibue and unleashes a powerful shot directed into the left side of the goal. The ball bounces in off the post, increasing the score of today's match. It's now 1:0.
42' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. A free kick is awarded to Como.

41' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Alessandro Prontera with no other option than to blow for a foul. It's a free kick to Como, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
40' Maximo Perrone (Como) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
39' A pass by Lucas Da Cunha (Como) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
38' Alberto Moreno (Como) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
37' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) commits a foul and Alessandro Prontera immediately signals a free kick.

37' Good chance! Andrea Belotti (Como) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
35' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) commits a rough challenge and Alessandro Prontera blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Como.
34' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
34' A raking crossfield pass from Florian Thauvin (Udinese) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
33' Patrick Cutrone (Como) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
32' Andrea Belotti (Como) latched on to a lofted pass inside the box, but his header misses to the right of the target. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
31' Udinese are ruled offside.
30' The Udinese players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
28' Foul! Maximo Perrone (Como) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. Udinese will take a free kick near the side line.
25' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
25' Alessio Iovine (Como) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.

24' The game is interrupted. Sandi Lovric (Udinese) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Como have a free kick.
23' Flag up against Jordan Zemura (Udinese). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
21' Alessandro Prontera has a clear sight and sees a foul from Sandi Lovric (Udinese). Como get a free kick.
21' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
20' Udinese keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
18' Alberto Moreno (Como) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Alessandro Prontera saw the whole situation. Free kick. Udinese will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.

17' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets too much on the ball and it goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
17' Alessio Iovine (Como) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Maduka Okoye intercepts the ball.
16' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
15' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
13' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Alessio Iovine (Como) but poses no threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
13' Como quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
12' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Como are awarded a corner kick.
12' Alberto Dossena (Como) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.

11' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
9' The linesman raises his flag. Patrick Cutrone (Como) is adjudged offside.
7' Udinese are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
4' Andrea Belotti (Como) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
4' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
4' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. Como will take a corner kick.
3' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Gabriel Strefezza (Como), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
2' The players claim that Andrea Belotti (Como) handled the ball inside the box and it seems they are right. There is a free kick near the sideline to Udinese.
2' Andrea Belotti (Como) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
1' Brenner (Udinese) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
1' The first half has started.
Como will kick-off.
Alessandro Prontera got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
